_comment: Maps DecoNetwork categories/product names to Google product taxonomy paths. Rules are matched top-to-bottom; the first rule whose keyword appears (case-insensitive) in the product's category or title wins. Values must match Google's official taxonomy (https://www.google.com/basepages/producttype/taxonomy-with-ids.en-US.txt) — verify/adjust for your catalogue. Anything unmatched falls back to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.
